scoring_justification: Compute-driven DFT task; the headline quantities are band gaps that can only be obtained through expensive DFT runs. A full recompute in the verifier sandbox is infeasible, so T0 result-level comparison against the paper's reported reference values with tolerances is the appropriate tier.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold band gap values from Table II and strain gaps from Figure 5 of the source paper; verified to match the reference oracle solve.sh output
hidden_assets.generation_method: extracted directly from the published article and cross-checked with the solve.sh expected outputs
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: the numbers are exactly the paper-reported GGA+SOC band gaps for the stated alloy compositions and strain conditions

schema.description: Six rows, one per system: Mo₀.₇₅Os₀.₂₅S₂, Mo₀.₇₅Os₀.₂₅Se₂, Mo₀.₇₅Os₀.₂₅Te₂, W₀.₇₅Os₀.₂₅S₂, W₀.₇₅Os₀.₂₅Se₂, W₀.₇₅Os₀.₂₅Te₂. Values in meV. 'metallic' for systems without a gap.

outputs.description: Computed global and direct nontrivial band gaps for all six Os-alloyed TMD monolayers.

schema.description: Seven rows for strains -2,-1,0,1,2,3,4. Direct gap in meV.

outputs.description: Direct band gap of Mo₀.₇₅Os₀.₂₅Te₂ as a function of biaxial strain.

output_contract.notes: The checker compares the submitted gap values to hidden paper-reported reference values with appropriate tolerances. Systems flagged 'metallic' in band_gaps.csv are checked for exact match of the string 'metallic'.
